title: Targeting TLR2 to Overcome Autophagy-Dependent Chemoresistance in Gastric Cancer: Integrating Molecular Docking, Mechanistic Validation, and Therapeutic Evaluation.
authors: Zheng, Kuanheng; Lei, Xinjian; Lin, Bin; Yang, Qianhong; He, Cong; Gao, Jin; Li, Feng
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TLR2小分子抑制剂克服胃癌化疗耐药，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chemoresistance remains a major barrier to effective treatment of gastric cancer (GC), particularly in advanced disease, where cytotoxic chemotherapy often yields limited and transient responses. The present study provides integrated computational and experimental evidence that targeting TLR2 using repurposed small-molecule inhibitors can overcome autophagy-dependent chemoresistance in gastric adenocarcinoma cells. A library comprising 1555 FDA-approved drugs was sourced from the DrugBank database, virtual screening was executed, and two compounds, Nilotinib (DB04868) and Lomitapide (DB08827), achieved affinities </= -10 kcal/mol. Chemoresistant GC cells were developed, and experimental assessment was performed using cell proliferation assay, apoptosis assay, real-time PCR, and western blot analysis. Nilotinib and Lomitapide significantly reduced the proliferation but increased the apoptosis of chemoresistant GC cells. Additionally, Nilotinib and lomitapide reduced the mRNA and protein levels of autophagy-related factors, LC3B, Beclin-1, and p62/SQSTM1, and activated transcription factors in chemoresistant GC cells. In conclusion, our results suggest that combining TLR2-targeted agents with standard chemotherapy could be a promising strategy to overcome refractory disease in GC.
abstract_zh: 化疗耐药仍是胃癌（GC）有效治疗的主要障碍，尤其是在晚期疾病中，细胞毒性化疗往往仅产生有限且短暂的应答。本研究提供了整合的计算与实验证据，表明利用重定位的小分子抑制剂靶向TLR2可克服胃腺癌细胞中自噬依赖性化疗耐药。从DrugBank数据库获取了包含1555种FDA批准药物的化合物库，进行了虚拟筛选，其中两种化合物——尼洛替尼（DB04868）和洛美他派（DB08827）——达到了</= -10 kcal/mol的结合亲和力。建立了化疗耐药GC细胞，并通过细胞增殖实验、凋亡实验、实时PCR和蛋白质印迹分析进行了实验评估。尼洛替尼和洛美他派显著降低了化疗耐药GC细胞的增殖，但增加了其凋亡。此外，尼洛替尼和洛美他派降低了自噬相关因子LC3B、Beclin-1和p62/SQSTM1的mRNA及蛋白水平，并激活了化疗耐药GC细胞中的转录因子。总之，我们的结果表明，将靶向TLR2的药物与标准化疗联合使用，可能是克服GC难治性疾病的一种有前景的策略。
